methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $22M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Pipedream is a Series A transportation company founded by Garrett McCurrach and Canon Reeves that has raised $22.4M to date. The transportation sector comprises eight private peer companies—including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, and REGENT Craft—with no public comparables available for direct benchmarking.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. Stage-Progression, the primary methodology, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $22M total raised as a baseline proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $45M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable; while three transportation-sector peers exist, none qualified under same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier filters, and a broad sector median would introduce undue noise given the heterogeneous nature of transportation subsectors.

The triangulated range spans $38M (low) to $52M (high), with a median of $45M. This range reflects the stage-progression result as its central estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow peer comparables—limiting cross-validation of the 2.0x multiplier against direct-stage comparables—and the limited visibility into Pipedream's unit economics, capital efficiency, and runway relative to peer companies. Given the single-method foundation, this valuation should be refined upon availability of additional peer data or company-specific metrics (burn rate, customer traction, path to profitability).
